page.layout: Printed fragment of a waste leaf pasted into the binding, printed upside down (rotated 180°). One block of text at upper right: a calendar-like column of black and red lines with numerals at the left edge of the block. Below it, a short red line, then a red word at lower right. A vertical column of small numerals runs down the middle left and upper left, outside the text block. A library sticker at upper left is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is a pasted, upside-down fragment of a printed leaf; most of the text is too damaged or rotated to read reliably, so most lines are marked illegible. The red line at lower right reads as "Augustinus" (the initial A is a red pilcrow-like mark). The numerals 9 to 15 in the lower middle and the small figures on the left are loose numbering, probably manuscript, and are not transcribed as text. The shelf mark "5 348" on the paper label at upper left is excluded. Ink stains and show-through cover much of the page.
